findings.rationale: Accepted: one definition of remaining — the consumer's. performReview gains budget_consumer (default review) used for both its exhaustion check and its clamp; performFinalPanel passes panel with every seat; the in-rail seat is byte-identical.

Accepted: "identical" is now defined as every digested body (seat receipt body :5156-5176 carries no timestamp; panel review_digest over seat digests in index order; validator view); ledger started_at/ended_at are informational and the one place concurrency is visible, by design.

Accepted: the refusal is one check at the top of performFinalPanel after the cross-family check and before any prepare; the reserve is its own field capped 0..1800 identically at graph checker, graph schema, projection, contract (mission-convergence :1465), contract schema and intake — all added to §2.5 with their mirrors and suites; the three max_wall_seconds caps are untouched.

Accepted: the helper is the only production launch path; the reviewDispatcher option (:2490/:3448) is a constructor test seam that replaces dispatchReviewJson before review.js is reached — not a second path. Byte identity is specified as reproducing spawnSync's observable contract (1 MiB maxBuffer with overflow → status null + error, status/signal as the child ended, cwd/env/stdin), pinned field-by-field; production timeouts stay dispatch-review.sh's own --timeout (rc=124), the helper backstop at --timeout+60 s reports signal like spawnSync.

Accepted: both stations read the same verificationEnvironment snapshot (:6589 → :7451/:7644) and allowlist; identity is content not timeline — the verification station already reuses across generations on the same rule (:7454-7455 recordGreenVerification(cached, repairGeneration)); stale ≡ identity mismatch.
Accepted: concurrency asserted from per-job started_at/ended_at (max(start) < min(end)) plus wall < sum − 1 s with 2/3/4 s sleeps — no approximate-slowest comparison.
Accepted: campaign-dispatch-projection.test.sh and mission-convergence.test.sh added to §4.1 and §2.5 (intake pins live in the routing/state suites already listed).
Accepted: the template/graph sentence is gone; the reserve default is 0 at every layer and a per-campaign graph sets it at that campaign's freeze.
